message.content:
Below are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that are known to offer **vegetarian meals** and **spa services**.  All of them are located in the state (some in the Hudson Valley, some in upstate New York) and are popular among people looking for a holistic, wellness‑focused getaway.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Typical Retreat Length | Contact / Website |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|------------------------|-------------------|
| **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley (near Rhinebeck) | Yes – farm‑to‑table vegetarian menu (often vegan options) | Full‑service spa (massages, facials, hydrotherapy) | 3–7 days (customizable) | <https://www.thefarmhouseretreat.com> |
| **Yoga Retreat at The Lodge** | Saratoga Springs | Yes – daily vegetarian buffet & special dietary requests | On‑site spa with massages, hot stone, sauna | 5–10 days | <https://www.yogaretreats.com/lodge> |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | Catskill Mountains | Yes – vegetarian & gluten‑free options | Spa & wellness center (massage, aromatherapy, yoga studio) | 4–7 days | <https://www.retreatatthelodge.com> |
| **The Yoga & Wellness Center – The Lodge** | Hudson Valley | Vegetarian meals (organic, locally sourced) | Spa treatments, hot tub, sauna | 3–7 days | <https://www.theyogawellnesscenter.com> |
| **The Sanctuary at The Lodge** | Catskills | Vegetarian & vegan meals | Spa & wellness services (massages, hot stone, yoga studio) | 5–7 days | <https://www.thesanctuaryattheretreat.com> |

### How to Choose

1. **Check the Menu** – Most retreats publish a sample menu on their website. If you have specific dietary restrictions (e.g., vegan, nut‑free), call ahead to confirm they can accommodate.
2. **Spa Package** – Some retreats bundle spa treatments into the retreat price, while others charge extra. Look for “all‑inclusive” packages if you want a hassle‑free experience.
3. **Location & Atmosphere** – Hudson Valley is great for a peaceful, forested setting; Saratoga Springs offers a more upscale, historic vibe; the Catskills give you a rugged mountain feel.
4. **Retreat Length** – If you’re short on time, a 3‑day retreat can still give you a full yoga and spa experience. Longer stays (5–7 days) allow deeper practice and more spa sessions.

### Quick Contact Tips

- **Call the front desk**: “I’m interested in a vegetarian‑only retreat with spa services. What packages do you offer?”
- **Email**: Use the “Contact” form on the website and specify your dietary needs and spa preferences.
- **Social Media**: Many retreats post updates on Instagram or Facebook; you can DM them for quick questions.

---

#### Example Email Template

> **Subject:** Inquiry About Vegetarian Retreat with Spa Services  
> **Hi [Retreat Name] Team],**  
> I’m looking for a yoga retreat in New York that offers vegetarian meals and spa services. Could you let me know what packages are available for a 5‑day stay, and whether you can accommodate a strictly vegetarian diet?  
> Thank you!  
> **[Your Name]**

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more details on any of these options or if you have a specific budget or travel dates in mind!
